decision: Security controls are enforced through deny policies.
why: Without deny policies, resources deploy in a non-compliant state, deviating from the security baseline.

links.note: Without the naming convention's deny prefix rule, deny policy assignments have no consistent identity.
Custom definitions provide the Deny effect where built-in policies don't — without them, deny coverage has gaps.

violations: Azure resource with public network access enabled.
Key Vault configured with Access Policies instead of RBAC.
Resource with minimum TLS version below 1.2.
Storage account with cross-tenant object replication enabled.
